newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper firm Apr-Sept cathodes output falls.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper firm Apr-Sept cathodes output falls.

text.p: India's state-owned Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) produced 14,251 tonnes of copper cathodes between April and September 1996, sharply down from 19,970 tonnes produced in the same period in 1995, a mines ministry statement said on Wednesday.
It said 2,970 tonnes of copper cathodes were produced in September 1996, against a target of 3,350 tonnes.
The statement said 19,564 tonnes of continuous cast copper rods were produced between April and September 1996 compared to 14,917 tonnes in April-September 1995.
